Term loan proceeds refinance the existing Meridian term loan of 5,600. [D1, §3 Note] [D2, §2.1(c)]

The draft does not state how the first-priority grant interacts with the Equipment Notes liens or the purchase-money Liens in §7.5(b)(iii). Refer to the underwriter and legal.
